messages:
olivia-sales: FYI customer trial (AcmeRetail) hitting a lot of 429s on embeddings route this morning — need a quick workaround and a path to a permanent fix.

mike-eng-runtime: which route? embeddings or chat?

olivia-sales: embeddings: POST /v1/embeddings (model: rdx-embed-8k) — they're seeing bursts after a batch ingest job. Getting `HTTP 429` with `x-rate-limit-*` headers in logs.

raj-eng-sre: can you paste the raw headers and a short curl we can replay?

olivia-sales: posted below from the customer. timestamped 10:12 UTC.

elaine-sol-eng: quick note — customer is on a trial token budget (50k tokens/day) + per-route cap default 60 rps. bursts from their batch can exceed the burst window.

olivia-sales: headers and sample (copied):

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 60
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 15
x-rate-limit-region: global
x-token-budget-remaining: 12854
```

and the curl they used:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rdx-embed-8k","input":[...batch of 200 texts...]'}
```

mike-eng-runtime: looks like a classic burst + per-route cap. We can do 2 things fast: 1) temporarily increase per-route cap for AcmeRetail to 120 rps for 24h, 2) suggest client add pacing in their batch (windowed concurrency 8) + exponential backoff on 429.

raj-eng-sre: agreed. I'll open a quick Emergency Quota change (internal ticket) and patch the customer's per-route cap. Need acct id and customer_id header used.

olivia-sales: acct_id 8421, customer_id header they include is `acme-8421`.

deploy-bot: Quota Change Request submitted: QCR-4529 — increase route /v1/embeddings for acct 8421 to 120 rps for 24h. ETA: ~10m

elaine-sol-eng: long-term: recommend enabling KV prefix caching for embeddings if they do repeated texts, and set up dedicated pool on Dedicated plan to avoid shared caps. Also review token budget — still plenty but wrong shape.

mike-eng-runtime: also flag for the infra team: consider smoothing burst window from 5s to 10s for routes with high batching patterns. I'll file RFC.

raj-eng-sre: change applied. they should see a drop in 429s now. olivia, can you confirm with the customer and ask them to retry with a 5s pause between batch slices?

olivia-sales: pinged them. customer confirms retries are succeeding now, 429s dropped to near-zero. They're asking whether an increase in trial quota is possible permanently while POC runs.

elaine-sol-eng: For pricing: we can offer a short-term elevated trial quota (up to 200k tokens/day) as a POC uplift. I can draft an amendment and pricing note for PS.

mike-eng-runtime: note for support docs — add a KB: "Handling 429s during batch ingests" with sample backoff code and recommended per-route cap requests.

olivia-sales: thanks team — I'll follow up with amendment + next steps. Closing the swarm for now. :thumbsup:
